title: Let producers leave full-suite criteria to Athena's checks
summary: The producer self-check (unmet_criteria in run.rs) stops sending a report back when a criterion is marked 'left to Athena's checks' and is a full-suite, fmt or clippy criterion. The producer brief (briefs.rs) tells producers how to mark it. Targeted-test criteria that are omitted or unmet still go back, and the verifier still judges the left-over criteria from the recorded checks. Audience: Athena's run loop and its verifier, which pay for the wasted send-back.

defaults_applied.how: The change is Rust code and Rust tests.
New unit tests cover the self-check and the brief; cargo test, clippy and fmt --check stay clean.
The criteria check the self-check outcome (sent back or not) and the verifier's failure, not that types exist.
The checks are the send-back decision for a full-suite criterion versus a targeted-test criterion, and the verifier still failing on a failed recorded check.
One focused change in the self-check, the brief and the changelog.
Doc comments and changelog entry are written for an outside reader.
The fix is in the self-check rule that wrongly counts Athena-owned checks as unmet, not in a retry or timeout.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Marking uses the existing met/unmet status plus a fixed evidence prefix "left to Athena's checks", so the CriterionStatusOutput enum and its JSON schema in outputs.rs stay unchanged (the request lists only run.rs, briefs.rs and CHANGELOG.md). A new enum variant would also touch outputs.rs.

Only criteria that name Athena's own recorded checks (cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy, the full or workspace cargo test) may be left this way. A criterion about a targeted test or any other behavior must still be reported met, so an omitted or unmet targeted-test criterion is still sent back. The criterion text must be recognizable as a full-suite check, not just marked by the producer.

Criteria left to Athena's checks are passed on to the verifier to judge from the recorded checks, the way a still-incomplete report is flagged today (run.rs near line 1947). The verifier fails the job when the recorded full-suite check fails, which is existing behavior and must keep working.
The job is urgent because it cuts a redo-work send-back that costs about 7 minutes per job.

acceptance_criteria.text: A unit test in crates/athena-core/src/run.rs shows unmet_criteria returns nothing for a report that marks a full-suite criterion (clippy, fmt --check and workspace cargo test) as left to Athena's checks, and still returns a targeted-test criterion that the report omits. Run: cargo test -p athena-core.

A test shows a criterion marked 'left to Athena's checks' that is not an Athena-check criterion (for example a targeted-test or content criterion) is still returned as unmet and sent back. Run: cargo test -p athena-core.
A test shows the verifier still fails the job when the recorded full-suite check fails, even though the producer left that criterion to Athena's checks. Run: cargo test -p athena-core.

The producer brief's criteria_check section in crates/athena-context/src/briefs.rs tells the producer to mark a criterion that only Athena's recorded checks (fmt, clippy, the full test suite) can show as left to Athena's checks, with the exact marker text, and says targeted-test criteria must still be reported met with evidence. A briefs.rs test asserts that wording.
CHANGELOG.md has an entry describing the change: self-check no longer sends back criteria left to Athena's checks.
cargo fmt --check and cargo clippy --all-targets are clean, and cargo test passes for the workspace (Athena's recorded checks).

out_of_scope: Changing how the verifier judges criteria or how Athena records fmt, clippy and test checks.
Re-running the full suite in the producer (decision d73effa stands).
The scope-guard work from job 20261026-015416-94rc and its cosmetic docs finding.
Changing the number of send-backs (PRODUCER_SEND_BACKS) or the send-back text beyond what the new marking needs.
urgent_reason: It removes a producer send-back of about 7 minutes (431 s in job 20261026-015416-94rc) that is redo-work caused by a criterion only Athena's own checks can show.
